title: agent-skills registry <-> router versioned contract (V3.1 P3)
description: Provider (registry) publishes a metadata-only versioned index; consumer (router) validates it. This document carries DIGESTS + metadata only — never skill bodies, never private paths in a public-safe build. POLICY_EPOCH / CAPABILITY_DECLARATION are advisory compatibility info, NOT execution authorization.

registry_schema_version.description: REGISTRY_SCHEMA_VERSION — provider schema major. Consumer accepts majors in its supported range; a newer major is incompatible and rejected.

registry_revision.description: REGISTRY_REVISION — monotonic build identifier (short sha of canonical content). Caller-supplied expected revision mismatch => STALE (degrade, never crash).

source_commit.description: SOURCE_COMMIT — git HEAD the registry was built at. Full 40-hex, or the literal sentinel 'unknown' when built outside a repo. Commit-anchored queries require a real SHA; 'unknown' degrades to advisory.

policy_epoch.description: POLICY_EPOCH — compatibility marker only. Mismatch with consumer's expectation degrades with a warning; it NEVER gates host tool execution (R3).

router_version_min.description: ROUTER_VERSION — minimum consumer version that can understand this contract. Consumer outside the range => incompatible.

layer_counts.description: Per-layer record counts at build time (reconciliation evidence).

skills.description: Metadata-only index entries. Body content is NEVER inlined — only body_sha256.

body_sha256.description: BODY_SHA256 — verifies body integrity only. HASH_VERIFIED != SAFE, and != MODEL_LOADED (R3).

capability_declaration.description: CAPABILITY_DECLARATION — advisory. Declaring a capability does NOT grant the host permission to use it.

host_compatibility.description: HOST_COMPATIBILITY — empty means any host. Non-empty and requested host absent => INCOMPATIBLE, refuse to load/enable.
